	set_country_flag = rpx_econ2_industrial_dominance
	rpx_econ_health_reward = yes
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = {
			free_building_slots = {
				building = industrial_complex
				size > 1
				include_locked = yes
			}
			OR = {
				is_in_home_area = yes
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						any_owned_state = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 1
								include_locked = yes
							}
							is_in_home_area = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_building_construction = {
			type = industrial_complex
			level = 2
			instant_build = yes
		}
